steps.what: Show the specification for this installation or repair.
Oversee installation, operation, maintenance, or repair of machines.

tasks.design: The {DOCS} store shows the specification already written for this machine or equipment. The mechanical engineer oversees the installation, operation, maintenance, or repair, and checks that it functions as specified. The specification does not oversee the work. A specification with no machine id leaves the oversight with the engineer.
tasks.previous_blocker: A machine was marked installed from the specification, and nobody had watched the work.
tasks.enabler_now: The stored specification can be opened. The oversight still happens at the machine.
tasks.still_hard: A function the specification does not mention still has to be seen by the engineer.
tasks.human_edge: The engineer oversees the work. The specification is the note already written.
tasks.altitude: Oversight stays at the machine. The specification is visible and is not the installation.

reach.task: Do the installation this engineer is overseeing.
reach.learn: A specification title is not the oversight.

evidence.claim: Opening a stored specification is a lookup. It does not oversee installation, operation, maintenance, or repair.
Marking a machine installed from the specification alone would record work that has not been watched.

assumptions: Workflow boundary: A mechanical engineer in a mid-size European company. A stored drawing is not the machine, and a draft is not the accepted design.

Fields: The specification id and the machine id, both already stored. The screen does not mark the machine functioning. If a required field is missing, the step stops and the mechanical engineer finishes it by hand.
Native check: Open the specification in the document store before the site oversight.
unknowns: Whether installation specs and repair specs share one record.
research_questions: Who confirms the specification is the one for the machine being installed?

already_counted.description: Overseeing the installation, operation, maintenance, or repair stays with the engineer.

incremental.description: Drop specifications whose machine record has been withdrawn.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: The engineer still oversees installation, operation, maintenance, or repair and still checks that the machine functions as specified. Only opening a specification that was already written is removed. A specification title saves none of the oversight.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Show the drawing the drafter already has open.
Assist drafters developing the structural design of products.

tasks.design: The {DOCS} store shows the drawing the drafter already has open. The mechanical engineer assists the drafter in developing the structural design. Drafting-tool runtime is not counted. The drawing does not assist anyone. A drawing with no drafter leaves the assistance with the engineer.
tasks.previous_blocker: A generated view was treated as the structural design, and the drafter had not been helped.
tasks.enabler_now: The open drawing can be shown. The assistance still takes the engineer with the drafter.
tasks.still_hard: A structural choice the drawing does not settle still has to be made with the drafter.
tasks.human_edge: The engineer assists the drafter. The tool does not develop the design.
tasks.altitude: Assistance stays with the engineer and the drafter. Drafting-tool runtime is not treated as saved labour.

reach.task: Keep the pen on the structural design.
reach.learn: A tool view is not the assistance.

evidence.claim: Opening the drafter's drawing is a lookup. It does not assist the drafter or develop the structural design.
Time a drafting tool already spends running is not the engineer's labour.

assumptions: Workflow boundary: A mechanical engineer in a mid-size European company. A stored drawing is not the machine, and a draft is not the accepted design.

Fields: The drawing id already open for a named drafter. The screen does not change the structural design. If a required field is missing, the step stops and the mechanical engineer finishes it by hand.
Native check: Open the drawing the drafter is already using. Do not start a second file.
unknowns: Whether every drafter stores the current drawing in the same store.
research_questions: Who is the drafter of record for this product?

already_counted.description: Assisting the drafter stays with the engineer.

incremental.description: Drop drawings whose product record has been withdrawn.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: The engineer still assists the drafter in developing the structural design. Only opening the drawing the drafter already has open is removed. Drafting-tool runtime is not counted, and a drawing with no drafter saves none of the assistance.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Show the stored question for this research test.
Conduct research that tests feasibility or performance of equipment.

tasks.design: The {DOCS} store shows the research question already written. The mechanical engineer conducts the research that tests or analyzes feasibility, design, operation, or performance of the equipment, component, or system. The question does not run the test. A question with no equipment id leaves the research with the engineer.
tasks.previous_blocker: A result from another component was filed as the answer to this research question.
tasks.enabler_now: The stored question can be opened. The research and the test still belong to the engineer.
tasks.still_hard: A performance the question does not name still has to be tested by the engineer, or left out on purpose.
tasks.human_edge: The engineer conducts the research. The question is the note already written.
tasks.altitude: The research stays with the engineer. A stored question is not the test.

reach.task: Use a research result this engineer has stood behind.
reach.learn: A question title is not the test.

evidence.claim: Opening a stored research question is a lookup. It does not test feasibility, design, operation, or performance.
A result stored for another component is not this research.

assumptions: Workflow boundary: A mechanical engineer in a mid-size European company. A stored drawing is not the machine, and a draft is not the accepted design.

Fields: The question id and the equipment id, both already stored. Results from another equipment id are not shown as this test. If a required field is missing, the step stops and the mechanical engineer finishes it by hand.
Native check: Open the question in the document store before the test.
unknowns: Whether feasibility tests and performance tests share one question record.
research_questions: Who links a research question to an equipment id?

already_counted.description: Conducting the research stays with the engineer.

incremental.description: Drop questions whose equipment record has been withdrawn.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: The engineer still conducts the research that tests or analyzes feasibility, design, operation, or performance. Only opening a question that was already written is removed. A question with no equipment id saves none of the research.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Show the stored alternate design or processing method.
Develop or test alternate models and assess feasibility.

tasks.design: The {DOCS} store shows the alternate design or processing method already stored. The mechanical engineer develops or tests the model and assesses feasibility, sustainability, operating effects, or whether a modification is necessary. Solver and test-rig runtime are not counted. A result stored for other conditions is not this test.
tasks.previous_blocker: A model result from another operating condition was treated as this assessment.
tasks.enabler_now: The stored design can be opened. The development, the test, and the assessment still belong to the engineer.
tasks.still_hard: An effect the stored design does not describe still has to be tested by the engineer.
tasks.human_edge: The engineer develops and tests the model. A stored result from other conditions is not this assessment.
tasks.altitude: The test and the assessment stay with the engineer. Solver and rig runtime are not treated as saved labour.

reach.task: Use an assessment this engineer made on this design's own conditions.
reach.learn: Another condition's result is not this test.

evidence.claim: Opening a stored alternate design is a lookup. It does not develop, test, or assess the model.
Solver and test-rig runtime are not the engineer's labour. A finished run can still be the wrong condition.

assumptions: Workflow boundary: A mechanical engineer in a mid-size European company. A stored drawing is not the machine, and a draft is not the accepted design.

Fields: The design id and the operating condition already stored for this test. A result for another condition is not shown as this assessment. If a required field is missing, the step stops and the mechanical engineer finishes it by hand.
Native check: Open the design for this condition. Do not reuse a result whose condition differs.
unknowns: Whether processing methods and product designs share one model record.
research_questions: Who confirms a stored result belongs to this operating condition?

already_counted.description: Developing, testing, and assessing the model stay with the engineer.

incremental.description: Drop designs whose test record has been withdrawn.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: The engineer still develops or tests the alternate model and still assesses feasibility, sustainability, or the need for a modification. Only opening a design already stored is removed. Solver and rig runtime are not counted, and another condition's result saves none of the assessment.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: The mechanical engineer still oversees the machine, still assists the drafter, and still runs the research and the model test. A stored sheet can be opened. It does not do the physical work.
reach: Installers work under this oversight, and this job learns a specification title is not the oversight.
Drafters hold the pen, and this job learns assisting them is still a conversation at the drawing.
skills_to_grow: Oversee installation and repair on the machine, not from the specification title.
Assist the drafter on the structural design instead of replacing them.
Test a model on its own conditions, and ignore a result stored for another case.
role.ambitious_version: Oversight, drafting assistance, research, and model tests stay with the engineer. Stored specifications and drawings only show what was already recorded.
